title: Nicholas Garton — Interim Order Application decision summary (2026-06-16)
text:
If you require any further information, please contact the Council’s Hearings Manager at Floor 29, One
Canada Square, London, E14 5AA or, by telephone, on 020 7580 3453
BEFORE THE FITNESS TO PRACTISE COMMITTEE
OF THE GENERAL OPTICAL COUNCIL

IO(26)03

___________________________________________________________________

INTERIM ORDER APPLICATION
DETERMINATION SUMMARY
16 JUNE 2026
___________________________________________________________________

PRIVATE HEARING

Name of Registrant: Nicholas Garton
Registration number: D-3170
Professional status: Dispensing Optician

Type and length of interim order: The Fitness to Practise Committee determined
to make an interim order of suspension from 16 June 2026 for a period of 12 months.

The order will be further reviewed within 6 months from today unless all matters are
resolved within that time, or earlier should new evidence be made available, or if the
registrant, at any time after three months from today’s date, requests an early
review.
court: General Optical Council — Fitness to Practise Committee
